description.p: Upeksha Alpha is a sleek, cross-platform productivity and timer application crafted for focused workflows, Pomodoro intervals, countdowns, and mindfulness sessions.

ul.li: Configurable interval timers, stopwatches, and Pomodoro sessions

Custom audio alerts and visual notification cues
Clean, modern user interface optimized for desktop environments
